incident: Rear-end collision at traffic signal. Airbags deployed. Significant chassis damage.
resolution_reason: Per Section 2.1 (collision cover): damage confirmed by independent surveyor. Depreciation of 8% applied per Section 4.2 for 2-year-old vehicle. Compulsory deductible Rs 2,000 applied.

incident: Emergency appendectomy. 2 days ICU, 3 days general ward. Total bill Rs 1,12,000.
resolution_reason: Per Section 2.1 (in-patient hospitalisation): emergency surgery covered in full. Room rent within limit (ICU 2% of Sum Insured). Pre-auth approved within 2 hours per Section 6.1. Deductible Rs 3,500 applied.

incident: Flood inundation of ground floor retail store. Stock and fixtures damaged.
resolution_reason: Per Section 2.1 (flood cover): peril confirmed by meteorological report. Underinsurance clause applied per Section 4.2: Sum Insured Rs 10L vs actual value Rs 14L → settlement ratio 71.4%. Stock loss of Rs 6L settled at Rs 4.28L; fixtures Rs 2.5L settled at Rs 1.78L (depreciation applied per Section 4.3).

incident: Vehicle theft. FIR filed. Non-traceable certificate obtained after 92 days.
resolution_reason: Per Section 5.2 (theft settlement at IDV): all required documents submitted — FIR, non-traceable certificate, all keys. IDV confirmed Rs 6,80,000. No depreciation on theft. RC transferred to insurer.

incident: Cataract surgery on both eyes. Day care procedure.
resolution_reason: Per Section 3.1 (2-year waiting period): cataract is a listed specific disease subject to 2-year waiting period. Policy tenure at time of claim: 18 months. Claim rejected. IRDAI guidelines confirmed this is a standard exclusion.
